title: Mrs Marion Bloom
html_source: He uses the same improper form for addressing a married woman. Correct would be “Mrs. Leopold Bloom.” This is yet another show of disrespect for the man.

anchor.prefix:
Balldresses, by God, and court dresses. He wouldn't take any money either. What? Any God's quantity of cocked hats and boleros and trunkhose. What?
